step1_analysis.circuit_type: Intelligent Power Amplifier MMIC with Adaptive Bias Control
step1_analysis.description: A high-linearity RF power amplifier that uses an on-chip adaptive bias control circuit. The bias circuit detects the input RF power level and dynamically increases the quiescent current of the main amplifier transistor at high power levels to improve linearity, while keeping it low at low power levels to maximize efficiency.

paper_reference.title: An Intelligent Power Amplifier MMIC Using a New Adaptive Bias Control Circuit for W-CDMA Applications

small_signal_gain.description: Small-signal voltage gain from input to output at the operating frequency (e.g., 1.9 GHz for W-CDMA).

paper_reported.value: Not explicitly stated, but typically 10-15 dB for such stages

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm * Rload. With W=2000u, Id=5mA, gm~100mS. Gain = 100mS * 50 = 5 V/V = 14 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the exact sizing of the main PA transistor and the load impedance.

max_output_power.description: Maximum RF output power delivered to the load before severe clipping.

sky130_expected.calculation: Pout = Vpeak^2 / (2*Rload). Max Vpeak ~ 1.5V for 1.8V supply. Pout = 1.5^2 / 100 = 22.5mW = 13.5 dBm.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scaled down for 1.8V CMOS process compared to higher voltage GaAs HBT.

quiescent_current_low_power.description: DC bias current of the main PA transistor with no RF input.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the adaptive bias loop settling point. Scaled for SKY130 NMOS W=2000u, expected around 5mA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for CMOS threshold and sizing to maintain class AB operation at low power.

dynamic_current_high_power.description: Average DC current of the main PA transistor under large RF drive.

sky130_expected.calculation: Adaptive bias increases Vgs, increasing average Id to support large RF swings. Expected ~30-50mA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Proportional to the required RF current to drive 50 ohms at 1.5V peak.

power_added_efficiency.description: Ratio of RF output power to DC input power (PAE).

sky130_expected.calculation: PAE = Pout / Pdc. Pout = 22.5mW, Pdc = 1.8V * 40mA = 72mW. PAE = 22.5/72 = 31%.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Typical for Class AB PA in CMOS.

step3_testbench.description: Measures small-signal gain, output power, static quiescent current, dynamic bias current, and efficiency.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Intelligent Power Amplifier MMIC Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Modified DUT (HBT -> X for subcircuit mapping, added Vshort for N6-N7)
X3 N5 N10 N9 npn_bias
X4 Vreg N5 N1 npn_bias
X1 N7 N1 GND npn_pa
RFC N7 VCC 1m
X2 N3 N4 GND npn_bias
Rb N1 N4 1k
R3 N3 N10 1k
R2 Vreg N3 10k
R1 Vreg N5 10k
R4 N9 GND 100
C1 N2 RFout 10p
C2 N1 RFin 10p
Cb N5 GND 10p
C4 N2 GND 100f
Cbypass N3 GND 10p
L1 RFin GND 10n
R7 N2 N6 0
Vshort N6 N7 0

* Subcircuits mapping NPN to SKY130 NMOS
.subckt npn_bias c b e
XM1 c b e e sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=50u l=0.15u
.ends

.subckt npn_pa c b e
XM1 c b e e sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2000u l=0.15u
.ends

* Supplies
VCC VCC 0 dc 1.8
Vreg Vreg 0 dc 1.8

* Input Source (1.9 GHz for W-CDMA)
Vac RFin 0 dc 0 ac 1 sin(0 0.5 1.9G)

* Load
Rload RFout 0 50

.control
  * 1. DC Analysis (Low Power Quiescent State)
  op
  let Iq_static = -i(VCC)
  print Iq_static
  let V_bias_static = v(N1)
  print V_bias_static

  * 2. AC Analysis (Small-Signal Gain)
  ac dec 10 100Meg 10G
  let gain_db = vdb(RFout)
  meas ac gain_19g find gain_db at=1.9G

  * 3. Transient Analysis (High Power Dynamic State)
  * Run for 300ns to allow the 100ns bias time constant to settle
  tran 10p 300n
  
  * Measure Output Power
  meas tran vout_max max v(RFout) from=250n to=300n
  meas tran vout_min min v(RFout) from=250n to=300n
  let vout_amp = (vout_max - vout_min) / 2
  let Pout_W = (vout_amp * vout_amp) / (2 * 50)
  let Pout_dBm = 10 * log10(Pout_W * 1000)
  print Pout_dBm

  * Measure Dynamic Bias Current
  meas tran Iq_dynamic avg i(VCC) from=250n to=300n
  let Iq_dyn_mA = -Iq_dynamic * 1000
  print Iq_dyn_mA

  * Measure Efficiency (Drain Efficiency ~ PAE for high gain)
  let Pdc = -Iq_dynamic * 1.8
  let PAE = (Pout_W) / Pdc * 100
  print PAE
  
  quit
.endc
.end
